storeOrders.title: Ordering app for shopkeepers
storeOrders.description: An app focused on shopkeepers for placing product orders, with mobile and web versions.

details.description: An app for placing product orders focused on shopkeepers. Users can access a catalog, select the products and quantities they need, choose when they want to receive their order, and pay on delivery.
details.context: Project developed as part of Asistencia Móvil's solutions.
details.role: Contributed to the development and maintenance of the mobile app, web version, and services related to the order flow.

businessSupport.title: Business support platform
businessSupport.description: A custom platform for managing business support and mentoring programs from a centralized dashboard.

details.description: A custom web platform designed to manage business support and mentoring programs, enabling organizations to manage companies, experts, assigned hours, sessions, follow-ups, and performance metrics from a centralized dashboard.
details.context: Project developed as freelance work for an independent client.
details.role: End-to-end development of the platform, collaborating directly with the client to define, refine, and implement business requirements and features.

rayShark.title: RayShark
rayShark.description: A mobile app for identifying fish species from the Colombian Caribbean, designed to work completely offline.

details.description: RayShark is a mobile app developed to make it easier to identify and consult information about fish species from the Colombian Caribbean. It includes information on 136 species and was designed to work without an internet connection through a local database.
details.context: A commissioned project developed during my sister's undergraduate studies in Biology. The app was submitted to an academic competition, where it won.
details.role: End-to-end development of the mobile app, implementation of the local Realm database, and development of the offline browsing experience.

brandingAgency.title: Branding and promotional products agency
brandingAgency.description: A corporate website for a full-service branding, marketing, printing, and promotional products agency, developed to showcase its services and make it easy for potential clients to get in touch.

details.description: A website developed for a branding and marketing agency that brings together several service lines, including brand building, printing, signage, garment decoration, and promotional products. The site was structured to present services clearly and guide visitors toward contacting the company.
details.context: Project developed to strengthen the company's digital presence and present its service portfolio to potential clients.
details.role: Frontend development of the landing page, layout of its sections, responsive design implementation, and development of calls to action.

beautyBusiness.title: Beauty business website
beautyBusiness.description: A landing page for a lash extension business, focused on presenting its services and prices and making it easier to book appointments.

details.description: A landing page for a lash extension business with information about its services, prices, policies, and contact details.
details.context: Promotional page developed for one of the clients of the company that contracted the development of this site.
details.role: Frontend development, responsive layout, and implementation of informational sections and calls to action.
